title: Act I — Wickmire
text: The bells of Wickmire stopped ringing the night the Lantern went out. Now the lamps float away, one by one. Somebody has to tie them down.

title: Act II — Whisperwood
text: The trees of Whisperwood are whispering about you. Look down. Nobody here has a shadow.

title: Act III — Echo Mines
text: Deep in the mountain, the miners still dig. They just can't remember why. Listen. Something is copying your footsteps.

title: Act IV — Rimehall
text: A king raised his cup for a toast. Then the light went out, and everything froze. The party is still waiting for the end of his sentence.

title: Act V — The Well of Hush
text: Below everything is the Well of Hush. Down there, up is down, and the only colour is you. Somewhere at the bottom is the sky.

title: The Deepdark
text: The Lantern is lit again. But the Hush didn't vanish. It sank under everything. Time to tidy up after a very long night.

title: Lamplight Hollow
text: A village on stilts. Every lamp is tied down with string. Warm soup, warm beds, warm people.

title: The Drowned Graves
text: The old graveyard slid into the bog. The Rattlebones woke up. They're wet and confused.

title: Bellcrypt Halls
text: Crypts under the bell tower. Something giggles in the dark. It sounds like a coin purse.

title: The Sunken Nave
text: A bell rings under the water. Everyone near it starts to yawn.

title: Belfry of the Drowned
text: The top of the sunken tower. A stone figure holds a bell. It never stops ringing.

title: Owlstead
text: Treehouses and rope bridges, lit by jars of glowworms. Mind the gap. Mind the owlets.

title: The Gossiping Birches
text: The trees are talking about you. "Nice boots." "Scared of moths, I heard."

title: Puffcap Hollow
text: Giant glowing mushrooms. Puff! Sparkles. Something hides under every cap.

title: The Owl Towers
text: Old stone towers full of Owlcrows. Their heads turn all the way round. They always see you.

title: Mother Bark's Pantry
text: Shelves and shelves of jars. In every jar, a shadow. They press against the glass.

title: Clinkerton
text: A mining camp on a giant lift. It goes up. It goes down. Mostly it creaks.

title: Saltwhistle Shafts
text: White salt tunnels. The wind whistles a tune nobody remembers.

title: The Glittering Gallery
text: Crystal caves that clink. Crystal Spiders clink too. If it goes quiet, look up.

title: Rattletrack Rails
text: Mine-cart tracks in the dark. One of the carts has teeth. Which one?

title: The Mouth of the Mountain
text: A cave so big it has weather. Whatever you do, it does too. Backwards.

title: Kettlekeep
text: The castle kitchens. The only warm rooms left. The big kettle is always on.

title: The Frosted Gardens
text: Hedges shaped like animals, frozen solid. Some of them aren't hedges.

title: The Looking-Glass Gallery
text: Halls of mirrors. Your reflection is a little bit late. Don't drink the tea.

title: The Everlasting Toast
text: Hundreds of frozen guests, cups raised, mid-cheer. They've been cheering for a year.

title: The Throne of Frost
text: An icy throne. A king who asks, "Who are you?" And then, "Who am I?"

title: Lastlight Landing
text: A lighthouse on the rim of the Well. The Guild's last hall. The only warm light for miles.

title: The Upside-Down Stars
text: You walk on the sky. The stars are under your feet. Some are fallen lanterns.

title: The Drift of Leftovers
text: Floating islands made of everything the Hush took. A bog stair. A birch. A ballroom door.

title: The Quiet Stair
text: A spiral stair going down to the sky. No sound at all. Your footsteps glow instead.

title: The Lantern Room
text: Inside the dark World-Lantern. A small grey figure sits by the cold wick.

title: The Deepdark
text: The underside of everything. Greyer. Quieter. The Snuffed down here are stubborn.

title: A Lightwell
text: Old light pooled at the bottom of this well. Gather what you can, then climb out and rest.

title: The Magpie's Hoard
text: A nest of glittering junk and real treasure. Shh. Grandmother Magpie is asleep.

title: The Candy Crypt
text: A crypt made of sweets. The Rattlebones here are sugar. They're very embarrassed.

title: Behind the Waterfall
text: A tea party. The guests are Snuffed. Nobody attacks. There's one empty chair.

title: The Sunken Bellringer
text: DONG. "Come home… come home… the dark is coming…" DONG.

title: The Sunken Bellringer
text: The stone cracks like an egg. A tiny old man blinks at you. "Oh. Did everyone get home?" He rings one bright note. Morning.

title: Mother Bark
text: "Thief! Shadow-snatcher! You'll not have my little darks!"

title: Mother Bark
text: Your light gives her a shadow for the first time in a year. She laughs, creaky and glad, and opens every jar. "Go home, little darks."

title: The Great Echo
text: "…olleh? …OLLEH?" (It's saying hello. Backwards. Very loudly.)

title: The Great Echo
text: "Dig deep, dig bright…" the miners sing. The mountain sings it back, the right way round. It isn't lonely any more.

title: The King Who Forgot His Name
text: "Who are you? Who… am I? No matter. Everyone must stay. Stay FROZEN."

title: The King Who Forgot His Name
text: "Aldric. My name is Aldric." The crown thaws. He raises his cup. "— and to all of you, who stayed." Pip runs to him.

title: The Grey Guest
text: "You came all this way. Please. Just let it stay dark. Then nobody has to carry it."

title: The Grey Guest
text: You share your light. His little lantern glows. Colour fills his coat. "You carried it," says Pell. "I thought no one would."

title: Dodge
text: Tap Dodge to roll through danger. Red on the ground means "move!"

title: Red means move
text: Red circles on the floor show where an attack will land. Step out of them.

title: Loot colours
text: Grey, blue, yellow, purple, orange… The brighter the colour, the more it remembers.

title: Green crown
text: A green crown means a Unique item. It remembers one special someone.

title: Sun symbol
text: Cyan-white with a sun? That's a Named item. You can only craft those.

title: Best gear
text: Not sure what to wear? Tap "Best gear" and your hero dresses up.

title: Simple mode
text: Simple mode can auto-attack, auto-pickup and equip clear upgrades. Undo is always there.

title: Homeward Wick
text: Use your Homeward Wick to go back to town from anywhere. It's free.

title: Bind your home
text: Talk to an innkeeper to make that town your Homeward Wick home.

title: Waypoints
text: Touch a waypoint once, and you can travel there any time from the map.

title: Free to town
text: Travelling to a town is free. Other waypoints cost a little gold.

title: Upgrades
text: The smith can upgrade items up to +15. It never fails. You see the cost first.

title: Kindle
text: Kindle is the spark left in an item. Crafting spends it.

title: Salvage
text: Don't need it? Salvage it into materials. The spark goes back into the world.

title: Any weapon
text: Every hero can use every weapon. Some just like certain weapons a bit more.

title: Proficiency
text: Use a weapon type a lot and you'll get better with it. For good.

title: Skill choices
text: At skill rank 2 and 4, pick a change to how the skill works. Try them all!

title: Free respec
text: Changed your mind? Skill points are free to reset until level 20.

title: Pets
text: Pets pick up loot for you. Some even dig up treasure.

title: Pet levels
text: Your pet grows with you. Adventure together and it levels up.

title: Mounts
text: Mounts make you faster. If something bumps you, you'll hop off.

title: Stablemasters
text: Every town has a stablemaster. Ask about mounts!

title: Elites
text: Glowing rings under enemies mean elites. They're tougher, and they drop better loot.

title: Magpie Imp
text: See a Magpie Imp? Catch it! It drops gold. Sometimes it leaves a door open…

title: Potions
text: Drink a potion when your light gets low.

title: Rested Glow
text: Time away fills your Rested Glow. When you come back, you learn faster.

title: Good place to rest
text: Each zone ends with a summary. It's a nice place to stop, or carry on.

title: Take a break
text: Breaks are part of the adventure. Your hero will be right here.

title: Lantern meter
text: The Lantern meter fills as you play. When it's full, something special drops.

title: Boss fragments
text: Collect 10 boss fragments and they make a boss material.

title: Mailbox
text: No room for a great item? Legendary and better ones wait for you in the mailbox.

title: Loot filter
text: Too much loot? The loot filter can hide the items you don't need.

title: Brightness
text: After level 60, every level makes your light brighter. Spend star points on the starmap.

title: Lightwells
text: Lightwells are short dives for old light. Stop halfway and you still keep what you found.

title: Difficulty
text: Finished the story? Try Nightfall. The Snuffed are tougher, the loot is better.

title: Last Flame
text: Last Flame heroes have one life. Only try it if you really want to. Normal play loses nothing.

title: Crafting stations
text: Each act has a new crafting station. The crafter there will show you how.

title: The Cauldron
text: Put things in the Cauldron to discover secret recipes. It never destroys an item.

title: Sockets
text: Put a gem in a socket. Rubies, sapphires, topaz and emeralds each help differently.

title: Glow
text: Lanternbearers build Glow by blocking and getting hit. Brave and bright!

title: Fury
text: Bellstrikers build Fury by hitting things. It fades if you stop. DING!

title: Thread
text: Stitchers spend Thread to sew dolls. Dolls fight so you don't have to be in front.

title: Combo points
text: Roofrunners build combo points with quick hits, then spend them on big moves.

title: Mana
text: Stargazers use Mana. It fills up again on its own.

title: Hold to aim
text: Tap a skill to aim it for you. Hold it to aim it yourself.

title: Layout
text: You can move your buttons around, or mirror them for left hands.

title: Light remembers
text: In Lumenholm, light remembers. Where light falls, things keep their colour, their sound and their names.

title: The Snuffed
text: The Snuffed aren't bad. They forgot who they are. Your light helps them remember.

title: Rekindled
text: When a Snuffed creature pops into sparks, it runs home. It says thank you, very quietly.

title: The Hush
text: The Hush isn't angry. It's just quiet. Too quiet, for too long.

title: Sparks
text: Loot is made from sparks of the World-Lantern. That's why every item remembers something.

title: The Guild
text: "A light shared is not a light lost." — motto of the Wickwright Guild.

title: Grey Guest
text: Every town has a story about a tall grey stranger who asked to come in and sit down.

title: Tolly
text: Wickmire's bellringer rang the evening bell for sixty years. Come home, come home.

title: Shadows
text: A shadow only exists where there is light. Think about that, in Whisperwood.

title: Owlcrows
text: Owlcrows sometimes ask riddles. Answer well. They remember.

title: The song
text: The miners of the Echo Mines had a song. "Dig deep, dig bright…" How did it go on?

title: Mirror Butlers
text: Mirror Butlers serve tea. The tea is a trap. They are very, very sorry.

title: The toast
text: In Rimehall, a king's toast was never finished. Everyone is still waiting.

title: Moths
text: Where moths gather, something is hidden. Look around.

title: The Tenth Lantern
text: Nine lampposts in every town. And one empty bracket. Keep an eye on the moon.

title: Mailboxes
text: There's an old mailbox in every act. Who keeps writing to you?

title: Up is down
text: In the Well of Hush, you climb down to reach the sky.

title: Magpies
text: Magpie Imps don't steal. They "borrow permanently". Big difference, they say.

title: The hub cat
text: Every town has the same grey cat. It's always asleep. Nobody knows how.

title: Bran's moths
text: Big Bran the smith is scared of moths. Please don't tell the Moth Choir.

title: Rest
text: "Carry the light. Share it when you can. Rest when you need to." — the Guild's rule.

title: Colour
text: In the Well of Hush, the world is grey. Every colour you see means something.

title: Before
text: Before the Lantern, there was only the Hush. No colour. No sound. Not bad. Just nothing much, like a room after bedtime.

title: The Wandering Spark
text: One day a spark drifted in from nowhere. The Hush said nothing. So the spark kept glowing. It was the first thing that ever remembered.

title: The First Wickwrights
text: Small folk built a lantern around the spark so it wouldn't blow away. They hung it high, so everyone could share. They called themselves Wickwrights.

title: Why Towns Dig Wells
text: Every town dug a Lightwell to catch spare light, like rain in a barrel. "For a dark day," they said. Nobody thought the dark day would come.

title: Tolly's Bell Log
text: Rang evening bell. All home. Rang morning bell. All up. — Rang evening bell. All home. (Sixty years of the same page. He never got bored.)

title: Tolly's Last Page
text: Lantern out. Rang the bell. Nobody came. Rang again. Rang again. Rang ag—

title: Mother Bark's Jar Label
text: "Shadow of a small fox. Handle gently. Likes to be near the window."

title: Old Hoot's Lesson
text: What is a star? A lantern very far away. What is a lantern? A star someone decided to keep close.

title: Foreman Pickwell's List
text: Why we dig: 1. ______ 2. ______ 3. ______ (Someone has drawn a small, sad face.)

title: The Work-Song
text: Dig deep, dig bright, bring the shine to light. Dig slow, dig true, the mountain sings for you.

title: The King's Toast (Draft)
text: To the Lantern, and to all of you — (He crossed out 'who came' and wrote 'who stayed'. He liked that better.)

title: Pip's Letter
text: Dear Dad. You forgot my name. That's okay. I remember it for both of us. It's Pip. Love, Pip.

title: Guild Rule Book, Page 1
text: Rule 1: Carry the light. Rule 2: Share it when you can. Rule 3: Rest when you need to. (Rule 3 is underlined. Nobody listened.)

title: Ada's Note
text: I meant to climb the stair and help him. Tomorrow, I said. For forty years, I said tomorrow.

title: A Name, Part 1
text: A torn scrap in grey ink: "My name is P…"

title: A Name, Part 2
text: Another scrap: "…I trim the wick every night. Nobody asks who…"

title: A Name, Part 3
text: "…I am so tired. If it goes out, maybe someone else will have to…"

title: A Name, Part 4
text: "…I only wanted to sit down. Just for a moment. Just in someone's warm kitchen…"

title: A Name, Part 5
text: "…ell. My name is Pell. If you find this, please say it out loud. I've nearly forgotten it."

title: Where the Hush Went
text: The Hush didn't vanish. It sank under everything, like the night sinking under the morning. That's alright. Night is good, when morning comes.

title: The Bellringer's Toll
text: It still rings, faintly, when no one is listening.

title: Drowned Lantern
text: Wet, cold, and somehow still burning.

title: Tolly's Morning Note
text: One bright DONG. Everybody up!

title: The Warden's Big Helmet
text: Two sizes too big. You'll grow into it.

title: The Unfinished Scarf
text: Long enough for a whole village. Nearly.

title: Squelchstriders
text: They squelch. Proudly.

title: The Last Warm Wick
text: A Candle Mage gave it back. Politely.

title: Rattler's Nightcap
text: Rattlebones sleep better in it. So do you.

title: Mother Bark's Shadow Jar
text: Empty now. It hums a lullaby anyway.

title: Birchwhisper
text: Each arrow tells a rumour on the way.

title: The Owlcrow's Eye
text: It always looks your way. Kindly, now.

title: Puffcap Hood
text: Sneeze-proof. Sparkle-positive.

title: Good Dog Collar
text: For the goodest hound in the Whisperwood.

title: Hob's Carved Acorn
text: The rune on it says 'grow'. It's trying.

title: Crown of Sticks
text: Twiglings bow when they see it. Then they poke it.

title: Dig Deep
text: It hums the first line of an old song.

title: Dig Bright
text: It hums the second line.

title: Clinking Silk Gloves
text: If they go quiet, check the ceiling.

title: Cart Six's Wheel
text: It always comes back.

title: Annie's Shawl
text: Warm. Warm.

title: Salty Heart
text: Tough on the outside. Salty in the middle.

title: The Going-Up Lever
text: Ding! Next stop: trouble.

title: The Everlasting Toast
text: Raised a year. Finished at last.

title: Warmhearth Crown
text: It thaws anyone who wears it. Especially inside.

title: The Sorry Tray
text: Serves trap tea. Deeply apologises.

title: Porcelain Smile
text: It only moves when you're not looking.

title: Tinwhistle's Medal
text: For bravery. And for saluting anvils.

title: Pip's Bossy Tiara
text: Royal orders, kindly given.

title: Chimney Kid's Hood
text: Smells of soot and adventure.

title: Jin-Jin
text: Frozen jester bells. They only get halfway.

title: Nobody's Spare Hat
text: …  (It is a very good hat.)

title: Quiet Stair Slippers
text: Every step leaves a little light.

title: The Hollow Choir's Bell
text: Rings without a sound. The Hush hears it.

title: Pell's Wick-Trimmers
text: Snip. Snip. Every night. For so long.

title: The Ninety-Ninth Chair
text: Someone finally sat in it.

title: Lastlight Lens
text: Makes small lights look very, very big.

title: The Stirring Ladle
text: Stir left for luck.

title: Nib's Borrowing Glove
text: Borrows gold. Permanently. Legally.

title: Magpie's Hoard Key
text: Opens a door that isn't there. Sometimes.

title: Cloak of a Thousand Wings
text: Soft. Fluttery. Slightly ticklish.

title: The Wandering Spark
text: The first thing that ever remembered.

title: Mantle of the Long Shadow
text: Every shadow wants to be close to a light.

title: The Morning That Never Came
text: Forged for a dawn that was cancelled. It is still waiting.

title: Last Spark of the World-Lantern
text: Rekindle all of Act V without your lantern going out once.

title: Grandmother's Needles
text: She knitted a scarf for every child in the village. The last one was never finished.

title: Moonthread
text: From the Tenth Lantern, on in-game full-moon nights.

title: The Bell That Doesn't Ring
text: The quietest bell in the world. The Snuffed hear it anyway.

title: Echo of Stillness
text: Stand still for 30 seconds while the Great Echo copies you.

title: The Owl's Last Question
text: The answer isn't in any book. We checked. All the books.

title: An Answer Nobody Knew
text: Answer 50 Owlcrow riddles in a row, then say 'I don't know'.

title: The Frog King's Croak
text: Every bolt croaks. That's not a bug. It's tradition.

title: A Frog That Never Jumped
text: Find it on a Wickmire lily pad in the rain. Walk. Don't run.

title: Soot Dust
text: Cold soot from lamps that went out. It still dreams of being warm.

title: Wickthread
text: Unburnt wick. Every lantern starts with a little of this.

title: Dusk Essence
text: A bottle of evening. Smells faintly of cocoa.

title: Ember Heart
text: A warm little core. Hold it and your hands stop being cold.

title: Bone Meal
text: Rattlebones leave this behind when they run home to bed.

title: Bell Shard
text: A piece of Tolly's bell. Put ten together and it rings again.

title: The Tenth Lantern
text: Nine lampposts. One empty bracket. On a full-moon night, a dark lantern hangs there. Light it.

title: Behind the Tenth Lantern
text: A tiny room. A small fire. A grey figure in a chair. "Oh. Hello. Sit down. I've heard about you."

title: A Letter For You
text: "Dear you. Mind the imp in the crypt. It's faster than it looks. — (a small drawn lantern)"

title: Another Letter
text: "Dear you. Behind the waterfall, sit still. Trust me. — (a small drawn lantern)"

title: Another Letter
text: "Dear you. When the mountain copies you, give it nothing. — (a small drawn lantern)"

title: Another Letter
text: "Dear you. Mind the third mirror. Your reflection isn't late there. It's early. — (a small drawn lantern)"

title: Another Letter
text: "Dear you. Don't fight to win. You'll know what to do. — (a small drawn lantern)"

title: The Last Letter
text: "Dear you. Your light never went out, because I lit it. From the other side. Carry it well. — You."

title: Snuffed, but Lovely
text: You sat still for a whole minute. The Snuffed poured you tea. It was cold. It was the nicest tea you've ever had.

title: The Frog That Never Jumped
text: It sits on a lily pad in the rain. It has never jumped. Not once. Walk slowly. It's thinking about it.

title: The Last Riddle
text: "What is the answer to this question?" The only right answer is "I don't know." The Owlcrow looks very pleased.

title: Echo of Stillness
text: You stood still. The Echo had nothing to copy. It waited. Then it whispered: "…oh. Quiet. Nice."

title: The Candy Crypt
text: A cracked wall in Bellcrypt Halls smells like toffee. Hit it. Go on.

title: The Grey Cat
text: It's the same cat in every town. When the moon is full, it purrs. It is not the Grey Guest. Probably.

title: The Ninety-Ninth Chair
text: Ninety-nine chairs in the Guild hall. After the Lantern is lit, one of them has your name carved on it.

title: A Warm Egg
text: It's warm. It wiggles. Carry it on your adventures. What hatches depends on where you go.

title: Lanternbearer
text: We've got this.

title: Lanternbearer
text: Stay in the light. Stay close.

title: Lanternbearer
text: Nothing to be scared of. …Mostly.

title: Lanternbearer
text: Brighter together.

title: Lanternbearer
text: Okay. Okay. Still glowing.

title: Bellstriker
text: DING!

title: Bellstriker
text: Group hug after this!

title: Bellstriker
text: Is that a spider? THAT'S A SPIDER.

title: Bellstriker
text: Everybody wake UP!

title: Bellstriker
text: Sorry! Too loud? Sorry!

title: Stargazer
text: Technically, that's a nebula.

title: Stargazer
text: It's 'whom', actually.

title: Stargazer
text: I read about this! The book didn't end well.

title: Stargazer
text: Star light, star bright — duck!

title: Stargazer
text: Please hold still, I'm calculating.

title: Stitcher
text: Say hello, Mister Buttons.

title: Stitcher
text: Snip, snip, stitch!

title: Stitcher
text: The dolls say you're very brave.

title: Stitcher
text: Nobody gets left unmended.

title: Stitcher
text: Oh, she likes you!

title: Roofrunner
text: Saw that coming. Totally.

title: Roofrunner
text: I once jumped over a whole castle. Twice.

title: Roofrunner
text: Is this yours? Kidding! …Kidding.

title: Roofrunner
text: Up and over!

title: Roofrunner
text: Quick, quiet, quality.

title: Rootweaver
text: Mm? Oh. Yes. Fighting.

title: Rootweaver
text: Slow roots, strong roots.

title: Rootweaver
text: I remember when this was a seed. So was I.

title: Rootweaver
text: Just resting my eyes… for a century.

title: Rootweaver
text: The beetles know the way.

title: Brannoc Sparkwell
text: This is Hammer Gerald. Say hello to Gerald.

title: Nettle Pim
text: Red potion: feel better. Blue potion: don't drink the blue one.

title: Madame Glimmerwick
text: Forty rings, and not one is the right one.

title: Grandpa Knurl
text: This spoon has a rune for 'soup'. Very useful.

title: Pocket Polly
text: Pocket forty-two… no, that's a frog. Sorry, frog.

title: Humphrey
text: Nothing… lost… in… a hundred… years.

title: Hattie Hayloft
text: Puddle says you look like a good rider.

title: Wren Whistleby
text: Pets pick up loot for you. Very professional.

title: Mother Mabble
text: Rest here and the Homeward Wick will bring you back.

title: Warden Hollis Reed
text: The helmet was my father's. I'll grow into it.

title: Grandmother Purl
text: Knit one, purl one, tell one story.

title: Flicker
text: Touch a waypoint once and you can come back any time!

title: Tamsin Knotwood
text: Sorry, log. This won't hurt a bit.

title: Professor Fennimore Puffcap
text: Alchemy: turning 'oops' into 'ooh!'

title: Cress Dewdrop
text: My best gem evaporated this morning. Again.

title: Hob Mossbeard
text: A rune on an acorn grows into a rune on a tree.

title: Mister Quibble
text: What's cheaper than cheap? A good deal!

title: Nutsy
text: I remember EVERY hiding place! …Most of them!

title: Ferris Longstride
text: *whistles* That means yes.

title: Juniper Fitch
text: Owlets sleep all day. Best job ever.

title: Bramble Hartwell
text: All our beds rock. Literally.

title: Ranger Sorrel Vane
text: Did you hear that? That was a whisper. Probably about me.

title: Old Hoot
text: What is a shadow, if not light's best friend?

title: Lumen the Glowworm
text: Touch a stone, it's yours to keep. Travel there before you sleep!

title: Dorra Anvilsong
text: CLANG! That's the chorus.

title: Fizzwick Drabb
text: Pop! That was supposed to happen. Mostly.

title: Opaline Facet
text: Every gem was once a bit of mountain dreaming.

title: Chisel
text: Carve. Tap. Glow.

title: Gus Two-Carts
text: Two carts, twice the bargains!

title: Pickett
text: Don't worry. The carts always come back. The track's a circle.

title: Mags Rattlebridle
text: Rock-ponies never get tired. They get sleepy. It's different.

title: Tuppence
text: Dimple digs up treasure! Some pets do that!

title: Barnaby Ballast
text: We pump fresh air all the way down! Breathe deep!

title: Foreman Hilda Pickwell
text: Why do we dig? It's on my list. The list is blank.

title: Echo Annie
text: The mountain used to sing to us. Us.

title: Lou Lever
text: Floor one: waypoints. Floor two: also waypoints.

title: Corporal Tinwhistle
text: *salute* That was for the hammer.

title: Cook Dumplina
text: Healing soup. Strength soup. Soup soup.

title: Lady Facetta Frostglass
text: A lady never giggles. *giggle* Oh dear.

title: Master Quillon Rimecarve
text: Ice holds a rune perfectly. Until it melts. Hence: no kettles.

title: Crumbsworth
text: Small shop. Big deals.

title: Mister Ledger
text: Item received. Item noted. Item cherished.

title: Noll Frostmane
text: Snow-hares hop over drifts. Boots don't.

title: Princess Pip
text: The royal corgi-hare is called Sir Wobble. Salute him.

title: Nan Kettleby
text: Tea for the cold, tea for the sad, tea for the tired.

title: Chancellor Pellinore Snowdrop
text: List of lists: item one, this list.

title: Tumblewit the Jester
text: Once there was a king with the warmest hall. …That's the sad part.

title: Tick
text: Tick. Tick. Calculating route. Tick. Done.

title: Mae Coalbright
text: I made your lantern's great-great-grandmother.

title: Mother Simmer
text: Put anything in. See what comes out. The Cauldron never breaks a thing.

title: Twinkle
text: Don't call me small. Call me concentrated.

title: Vesper Inkwell
text: A rune of light lasts as long as someone reads it.

title: Nib
text: I used to be a Magpie Imp. Now I'm a magpie businessman.

title: Keeper Stillwater
text: Nothing here is in a hurry. Least of all me.

title: Captain Loft
text: Great moths fly toward light. That's you. Handy!

title: Tansy Glow
text: Every night I open the jars. Every morning they come back.

title: Aunt Lumi
text: A lit window means someone's waiting for you.

title: Ada Brightly
text: A light shared is not a light lost. That's the Guild's rule.

title: The Moth Choir
text: *sing* Once was a spark that wandered alone…

title: Nobody
text: …  (Nobody points at the map. Politely.)
